sources.title: GitHub - DakeBU/DPRM-DLLM: Official Implimentation of paper DPRM: A ...
sources.snippet: DPRM-DLLM Official Implimentation of paper DPRM: A Plug-in Token-Ordering Module for Diffusion Language Models. DPRM-DLLM is a plug-in token-ordering module for masked discrete diffusion and diffusion language models. It does not replace your model, denoising objective, reward model, verifier, tokenizer, data loader, or search scaffold.

sources.title: DPRM: A Plug-in Token-Ordering Module for Diffusion Language Models
sources.snippet: DPRM improves pretraining, post-training, test-time scaling and single-cell masked diffusion, with strong gains on harder reasoning subsets. In protein, molecular and DNA generation, ordering-aware variants improve selected structural, fragment-constrained or reward-specific metrics, though not every quality metric.

sources.title: DPRM: A Plug-in Doob h transform-induced Token-Ordering Module for ...
sources.snippet: We intro-duce DPRM(Doob h-transform Process Reward Model), a plug-in token-ordering module that keeps the host architecture, denoising objective and supervision unchanged, and modifies only the ordering policy. DPRM starts from confidence-driven ordering and gradually shifts to process-reward-guided ordering through online estimates.
